text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, prochlorperazine is not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 139 units at 7.8 units per day for 18 days on hand. Corvale General holds 162 units at 8.6 units per day for 19 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 26 units at 1.5 units per day for 18 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): The product label identifies PD-Rx Pharmaceuticals, Inc. as the labeler and plant with FEI 1641825. FDA inspection 1331942 of PD-Rx Pharmaceuticals, Inc. ended 2026-08-20 with VAI classification and was known 2026-10-12. Prior FDA inspections of the same plant on 2015-12-04 and 2022-11-10 were also classified VAI.

Our position: Current inventory provides approximately 18 to 19 days of supply across sites. No FDA shortage listing exists. The manufacturer has a history of VAI inspection classifications, most recently in August 2026.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate purchase from Cosette Pharmaceuticals, Inc. and Padagis US LLC; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list daily and report changes to P&T committee chair; requires no additional approval.
3. Buyer to request updated supply allocation timeline from PD-Rx Pharmaceuticals, Inc.; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
